## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete numerical or software change and link its issue.

## Target and data contract

State changes to targets, assumptions, units, basis conventions, public interfaces, or information sets. Link the updated API or methods documentation.

## Validation

List relevant checks, reference calculations, experiment commands/seeds, numerical tolerances and any inspected visualization outputs.

## Limits and review

State material limitations and requested numerical review. Preserve source provenance and keep private research and restricted data outside the public tree.
